task: How fast do refunds have to go out?
answer:
Once we tell a customer a refund is on its way, it must be issued within 3 working days according to the Refund policy.

* If we miss that date, we must apologise first, issue the refund the same day and add a 10% voucher for the next order.

data.title: Refund policy
data.heading: How fast refunds must go out
data.text: Once we tell a customer a refund is on its way, it must be issued within 3 working days. If we miss that date, apologise first, issue the refund the same day and add a 10% voucher for the next order.

data.title: Courier Y agreement (service terms)
data.heading: Review and exit
data.text: The agreement is reviewed after 60 days. If on-time delivery is below 90% for two weeks in a row, we can end it with 14 days' notice.

data.title: Delivery standard: west region
data.heading: What we tell west customers
data.text: Orders in the west region are delivered within 2 days. This standard relies on Courier Y running Hub W2 on time; it was set after the courier switch.

data.title: Courier Y agreement (service terms)
data.heading: Service level
data.text: Courier Y runs all west deliveries through Hub W2 and commits to at least 90% of parcels on time each week. Hub W2 is rated for 14 parcels a day.

data.title: Operations meeting notes, 18 Aug
data.heading: Decision: move west deliveries to Courier Y
data.text: Agreed to move west deliveries to Courier Y to lower delivery cost (figures in the finance cost sheet). Owner: the logistics manager. Assumption recorded: Courier Y delivers at least 90% on time through Hub W2.
